Argentina.name: Argentina
objectives: Protect agricultural export interests and commodity prices
Maintain economic sovereignty from US influence
Secure fair terms for commodity exporters in new order
Lead Latin American bloc in negotiations
Develop industrial base through import substitution
Resist IMF conditions that threaten social programs
Argentina.economicPosition: Prosperous neutral during war, creditor nation (UK owes £150M), strong agriculture, emerging industry under Perón
specialAbilities: Commodity Power: Can influence global grain and beef prices
Third Position: Bonus points for policies that differ from both USA and USSR
Latin American Leadership: Votes count extra on development issues
Argentina.historicalContext: Argentina remained neutral in WWII, profiting from food exports. By 1946, Perón has nationalized British railways and created the 'Third Position' - neither capitalist nor communist. Major creditor to war-devastated Europe.
